status.not_set_up: This model is not set up: add its key in Settings or pick another one

notice.grounded_failed_title: The model could not answer from the sources
notice.no_model_body: Add a key in Settings › Model providers and keys, load a model on this device or connect your own server. Grounded mode also answers without a model, by quoting your sources.
notice.no_vision_model: None of the models set up can see images. Add a key of a provider whose models read images, or ask without the image.
notice.image_not_source: {name} was not added to your sources: reading text in images needs a model that can see, and your consent.
notice.rate_limited_wait: Too many requests at the provider right now: please wait {seconds} s and try again.
notice.stays_on_device_title: This question stays on this device
notice.stays_on_device_body: It was asked on this device, so only the model here or your own server answers it. Pick one of them, or ask the question again as a new message.
notice.failed_body: Something went wrong while answering. Please try again.
notice.store_failed: The chat could not be stored in this browser (private window, blocked or full storage).
